title: Fix ObjectGantt tests: handle duplicate text in sidebar and chart
body:
ObjectGantt renders task names in both the sidebar list and the gantt chart visualization. Tests using `getByText()` failed with "Found multiple elements" errors.

## Changes

- Updated test queries from `getByText()` to `getAllByText()` with length assertions
- Affected tests: "should fetch and display gantt data", "should render with inline data", "should handle task click"

```diff
- expect(screen.getByText('Task 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
+ expect(screen.getAllByText('Task 1').length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
```

This is the correct Testing Library pattern when text appears in multiple DOM locations.
